top.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash compresses KV cache hard
top.newly_possible: Long-context agent workloads can run with lower compute, storage and bandwidth cost through aggressive KV cache compression.

sources.name: Hugging Face daily papers
sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression

top.title: Claude Code falls back to AGENTS.md
top.newly_possible: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md when there is no Claude.md, so one instruction file can serve several coding agents.

sources.name: Hacker News
sources.title: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md if there is no Claude.md

top.title: Google releases AX, an open agent orchestrator
top.newly_possible: You can look at an open agentic orchestrator from Google for coordinating agent runs.

top.title: deja-vu shares one memory across coding agents
top.newly_possible: You can search and reuse fixes from past sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI and others, using history already on disk.

top.title: Tool-calling model small enough for microcontrollers
top.newly_possible: You can run tool calls, structured extraction and embeddings from a 2-bit model of 8 to 29 MB on phones, wearables, robots and microcontrollers.

top.title: Secure tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI
top.newly_possible: You can connect private or localhost MCP servers to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API and AgentKit without exposing them to the public internet.

top.title: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG document index
top.newly_possible: You can index documents for retrieval without a vector database and let the model reason over the index.

top.title: Transformers.js 4.3 adds structured output in browser
top.newly_possible: You can force a model running in the browser to follow a JSON schema or a regex, token by token.

sources.name: YouTube: Hugging Face
sources.title: Structured Output in the browser with Transformers.js 4.3

top.title: SoL-Pi cuts coding agent token costs by a third
top.newly_possible: Autonomous coding agents can run self-improvement loops at about one third lower token cost while keeping performance.

sources.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness

sources.title: Kev: Tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5
